response.sql: WITH regional AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS average_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE CAST(t.date AS TEXT) BETWEEN '1996-05-09' AND '1998-01-06' GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_signed_amount) AS average_of_regional_averages FROM regional) SELECT r.region, r.average_signed_amount, r.transaction_count, r.average_signed_amount / o.average_of_regional_averages AS ratio FROM regional AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_of_regional_averages IS NOT NULL
